get.description: Lists the outlets visible to the caller.

parameters.name: organization_id
parameters.description:
UUID of the organization whose outlets to list. Anonymous callers need it,
or an id or code selector, to receive rows; authenticated callers only
ever see outlets of their own organization.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Filter by one or more outlet UUIDs.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of the outlet name.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Exact outlet codes; repeat the parameter to match any of several.

parameters.name: is_master
parameters.description: Return only master (true) or only non-master (false) outlets. Omit for both.

parameters.name: with_owner
parameters.description: When true, include a lightweight owner object (id, name, profile image) in each outlet.

parameters.name: with_organization
parameters.description: When true, include a lightweight organization object (id, code, name, logo) in each outlet.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of the outlet name.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description:
Page number (1-based). Selects page mode; mutually exclusive with after
and before.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description:
Items per page. Defaults to 20, max 100 (larger values are clamped and
echoed as page_size).

parameters.name: after
parameters.description:
Opaque cursor: the page after this position. Pass a previous response's
next_cursor.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description:
Opaque cursor: the page before this position. Pass a previous response's
prev_cursor.

parameters.name: total
parameters.description:
Whether to count matching rows. Default: exact in page mode, none in
cursor mode.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Comma-separated sort fields, e.g. "name" or "-create_at,name". Each field
sorts ascending unless prefixed with "-" for descending.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description:
Filter is the client-supplied filter group. Query and form parameters
use unpadded base64url-encoded JSON; JSON bodies use an object.

BusinessHours.description:
Weekly opening hours. A null organization schedule means hours are unset.
A null outlet schedule inherits the organization's current hours.

BusinessHoursDay.description:
Opening hours for one day. An empty `intervals` array means the outlet
or organization is closed. The server changes `revision` only when this
day is edited or reset.

intervals.description: Opening intervals of the day in start order, at most eight; empty when closed.

revision.description: Revision of this day, changed only when the day is edited or reset.

BusinessHoursIntervalOutput.description:
BusinessHoursInterval is a half-open local-time interval within one day.
Midnight-crossing openings are split into intervals on consecutive days.

start.description: Opening time in local HH:mm, e.g. "09:00".

end.description: Closing time in local HH:mm, after start; "24:00" closes at midnight.

Group.description:
Group combines `rules` and nested `groups` using `conjunction` (`AND` or
`OR`). Set `negated` to true to reverse the result of the whole group.

To filter by related resources, set `edge` to the relationship name and
choose a supported `quantifier` (`SOME`, `EVERY`, or `NONE`). Use field
names from the related resource in that group's rules.

Outlet.description:
An outlet and its organization, owner, and operating settings. Anonymous
callers receive the basic directory projection, which omits the audit
instants, description and owner.

create_at.description: When the outlet was created (UTC). Absent in the basic directory projection.

update_at.description: When the outlet was last updated (UTC). Absent in the basic directory projection.

delete_at.description:
When the outlet was deleted (UTC). Always absent here: outlet reads never
return deleted outlets.

code.description:
Business code of the outlet, unique across organizations. Look an outlet
up by code with the list's exact code selector.

description.description: Free-text description. Absent when unset or in the basic directory projection.

address.description: Physical address of the outlet. Absent when unset.

phone.description: Phone with an explicit country code: "+<country code> <number>" or "(<country code>)<number>", e.g. "+60 123456789". A space or hyphen may separate a plus-prefixed country code from the number. The number accepts spaces, hyphens, periods, and simple balanced parentheses around area codes. Compact E.164 strings such as "+60123456789" use assigned ITU calling codes, validated at runtime. Output is canonical "(60)123456789".

timezone.description:
IANA time zone override for this outlet, e.g. "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur". Empty
or absent means the organization's timezone applies (see the organization
expansion).

business_hours_revision.description:
Revision of the outlet's whole business-hours schedule, kept across
resets; an inheriting outlet uses its own revision.

is_master.description: Whether this is a master (headquarters) outlet of its organization.

organization_id.description: UUID of the organization that owns the outlet.

owner_id.description: UUID of the outlet's owner. Absent in the basic directory projection.

OutletOrganization.description:
Organization details included in an outlet response. The contact fields
(phone, address, email, website) appear only in the basic directory
projection.

phone.description: Public contact phone of the organization. Basic directory projection only; absent when unset.

address.description: Public address of the organization. Basic directory projection only; absent when unset.

phone.description: Phone with an explicit country code: "+<country code> <number>" or "(<country code>)<number>", e.g. "+60 123456789". A space or hyphen may separate a plus-prefixed country code from the number. The number accepts spaces, hyphens, periods, and simple balanced parentheses around area codes. Compact E.164 strings such as "+60123456789" use assigned ITU calling codes, validated at runtime. Output is canonical "(60)123456789".

email.description: Public contact email of the organization. Basic directory projection only; may be empty.

website.description: Website of the organization. Basic directory projection only; may be empty.

timezone.description: Organization timezone used as the fallback when the outlet's timezone is empty.

business_hours_revision.description: Revision of the organization's whole business-hours schedule, kept across resets.

logo.description: Logo of the organization. Absent when unset.

Quantifier.description:
Quantifier controls how a filter group matches related resources when
`edge` is set. Use `SOME` for at least one match, `EVERY` for all, or `NONE`
for no matches. Only resources you can read count.

Rule.description:
Rule is a single filter condition. Set `field` to the field name and `op`
to the comparison operator. Supply a JSON `value` if the operator takes one.

TotalMode.description: TotalMode selects whether a list response counts its rows.

anyOf.description: Any weighted language-range list, e.g. "ms-MY, en;q=0.8".

CorrelationId.description: Correlation id of the request (the problem's correlation_id); the lookup key in logs and traces.

ProblemContentLanguage.description: Languages used in the problem text: the negotiated language, plus en when some text fell back to English (e.g. "ms, en").

ProblemVary.description: Always lists Accept-Language (merged with other tokens such as Accept-Encoding).
